net.lemnik.eodsql.spi.util

Class ResultSetWrapper<T>

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.lemnik.eodsql.spi.util.ResultSetWrapper<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - the wrapping type that this ResultSetWrapper will return
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    DataIteratorWrapper, DataSetWrapper

    public abstract class ResultSetWrapper<T>
extends Object

    A ResultSetWrapper allows is used to wrap a normal ResultSet object in the type requested by a Query interface. Implementations of this class are not responsible for binding the actual data-objects, but instead for creating their collection wrappers. Default implementations exist for the following types:

    • DataSet
    • DataIterator
    • Set - unmodifyable
    • SortedSet - unmodifyable
    • List - unmodifyable
    • Collection - unmodifyable (underpinned by a List)
    • Arrays
    • Single Data Objects, or primitives

    A single ResultSetWrapper implementation may optionally return any number of different types. For example the built in CollectionResultSetWrapper returns List, Set, SortedSet and Collection implementations. The ResultSetWrapper may also need to bind multiple data-objects per row (or none), thus the ResultSetWrapper.Factory class exists to determine which ResultSetWrapper should be used for a given set of parameters and a return-type.

    Author:
    Jason Morris

    • Method Detail

      • wrap

        protected T wrap(ResultSet results)
          throws SQLException

        This is a utility method for those ResultSetWrapper implementations that don't need any of the additional information stored in a Context object, and want the Context to be auto-closed when this method call exits.

        By default this method throws an UnsupportedOperationException. If you do override the wrap(net.lemnik.eodsql.spi.Context) method, there is no reason to override this method.

        Parameters:
        results - the ResultSet to wrap
        Returns:
        the ResultSet wrapped in a new wrapper object
        Throws:
        SQLException - if a database error occures
        See Also:
        wrap(net.lemnik.eodsql.spi.Context)

      • wrap

        public T wrap(Context<?> context)
       throws SQLException
        Wrap the given Context in whatever type this ResultSetWrapper should return. This method by default makes a call to wrap(java.sql.ResultSet), but can be overriden if required (for example to switch of autoclose).
        Parameters:
        context - the full Context to wrap
        Returns:
        the given Context wrapped in a new wrapper object
        Throws:
        SQLException - if a database error occures

      • getPreferredResultSetType

        public int getPreferredResultSetType()

        Returns this ResultSetWrapper objects preferred type of ResultSet. This method should return the same as should be returned by ResultSet.getType().

        By default this method returns ResultSet.TYPE_SCROLL_INSENSITIVE, which is used by most of the underlying implementations.

        Returns:
        ResultSet.TYPE_SCROLL_INSENSITIVE by default

      • getPreferredResultSetConcurrency

        public int getPreferredResultSetConcurrency()

        Returns this ResultSetWrapper objects preferred concurrency for a ResultSet. This method should return the value expected from ResultSet.getConcurrency().

        By default this method returns ResultSet.CONCUR_READ_ONLY, which is used by most of the underlying implementations.

        Returns:
        ResultSet.CONCUR_READ_ONLY by default

      • getKeyColumnNames

        public String[] getKeyColumnNames()
        If this ResultSetWrapper has a list of key column names that should be requested from the database during an update, this method should return that list.
        Returns:
        DataObjectBinding.NO_KEY_COLUMNS by default
        See Also:
        DataObjectBinding.getKeyColumnNames()

      • addFactory

        public static void addFactory(ResultSetWrapper.Factory factory)

        Hand register a ResultSetWrapper.Factory object. This method can be used under Java 1.5 where the ServiceLoader class is not avaiable. If a Factory of the given type is already known, this method does nothing.

        This method is not thread-safe, and should only ever be invoked by one Thread at a time.

        Parameters:
        factory - the Factory to add
        See Also:
        Factory - for more information

      • removeFactory

        public static void removeFactory(ResultSetWrapper.Factory factory)

        Remove a registered ResultSetWrapper.Factory object. This method will first check to see if the specified Factory object is already registered, if it is, the Factory will be removed from registration.

        This method is not thread-safe, and should only ever be invoked by one Thread at a time.

        Parameters:
        factory - the Factory to unregister
        See Also:

      • get

        public static ResultSetWrapper get(Type genericReturnType,
                                   Map<String,Object> parameters)
                            throws InvalidDataTypeException,
                                   InvalidQueryException

        Returns a ResultSetWrapper for the given genericReturnType and parameter Map. This method will first check to see if the genericReturnType is a primitive type or a data-object, if it is a special ResultSetWrapper implementation will be used.

        If the returned objects are not "simple" (as defined above), the method will look backwards through the list of ResultSetWrapper.Factory objects. As soon as a ResultSetWrapper.Factory.isTypeConstructable(java.lang.reflect.Type, java.util.Map) call returns true, this method will use that Factory's create method and return the resulting ResultSetWrapper.

        If no Factory would be able to create a wrapper for the given parameters, this method will return null.

        Parameters:
        genericReturnType - the generic type that needs to be returned from the method implementation
        parameters - a Map of parameters that will be passed to the ResultSetWrapper.Factory
        Returns:
        a ResultSetWrapper that will wrap a ResultSet according to the given parameter Map and return the requested type
        Throws:
        InvalidDataTypeException - if the ResultSetWrapper.Factory cannot construct a data-object of the requested type
        InvalidQueryException - if the ResultSetWrapper.Factory cannot create a wrapper for the given parameter Map
